mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (indicating accommodative monetary policy) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, compressing valuation multiples and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation with returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and heightened recession risk, triggering reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1350.0) and real consumption (RSAFS < 520000.0) indicates broad-based demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction condition fails: > 40% of triggered instances show positive 20-day returns or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) increases borrowing costs and reduces liquidity, depressing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% or Rank IC in tightening regime < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO > 110.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity and strong corporate earnings, compressing risk premiums and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor of 60-day returns < 0.03 over any 3-year window or correlation not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300.0 thousand units signals residential sector contraction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0 or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in job growth (PAYEMS < 150000.0) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 3.8%) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction condition fails: > 40% of triggered instances show positive 20-day returns or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Supply chain disruption (INDPRO < 105.0) reduces manufacturing output and corporate profitability, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 or Rank IC in disruption regime < 0.03.
